title: ASML reports Q1 net sales of €8.8B, vs. €8.5B est., and €2.8B net profit, vs. €2.5B est., and raises 2026 net sales forecast to €36B-€40B from €34B-€39B (Arjun Kharpal/CNBC)
summary: Arjun Kharpal / CNBC: ASML reports Q1 net sales of €8.8B, vs. €8.5B est., and €2.8B net profit, vs. €2.5B est., and raises 2026 net sales forecast to €36B-€40B from €34B-€39B — ASML raised its sales forecast for 2026 after it beat first-quarter revenue and profit expectations …
contentText:
Arjun Kharpal / CNBC :

ASML reports Q1 net sales of €8.8B, vs. €8.5B est., and €2.8B net profit, vs. €2.5B est., and raises 2026 net sales forecast to €36B-€40B from €34B-€39B   —  ASML raised its sales forecast for 2026 after it beat first-quarter revenue and profit expectations …
